::: {#sol-documentation}

What it is,
what it was trained on,
what it is meant for,
how well it does,
on which inputs it does worse,
and what it was never tested on.
A single [accuracy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy) answers only the fourth.
Its [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set) and [validation set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-validation-set) hold digits from the same 13 writers,
so how well it reads another person's handwriting is unknown,
and its users should be told so.

:::
